citations.assessment: The Bavli confirms Chananyah son of Chizkiyah son of Garon in the attic episode.

holds.reason: The attic incident names Chananyah son of Chizkiyah and the two houses. The reports do not date the father specifically to Hillel’s lifetime.

evidence.witness: The Jerusalem Talmud, edition by Heinrich W. Guggenheimer. Berlin, De Gruyter, 1999-2015

notes.text: The Bavli and Yerushalmi corroborate the son and patronymic. The chronology attached to the father remains qualified.
